statement: At Linux v7.4-rc2, Switch 2 Pro USB identity is handled by two coordinated paths: a USB HID interface carries input reports and rumble outputs, while a vendor-class USB configuration interface supplies dynamically discovered bulk IN and OUT endpoints for command/reply setup. The kernel attaches both parts by USB physical topology. This is not a HID-only device initialization path.

applicability.scope: Pinned Linux USB/HID enumeration and configuration
